title: Aquarius took a fake call in aisle five
old_caption: The ex appeared at the end of the cereal aisle, so Aquarius called the space station. Then the phone actually rang. The wave back was with a melon. What's your ex-sighting move?

title: Pisces cried at their own birthday text
old_caption: Pisces wrote a birthday text, cried, edited it, cried more, then read it out to the plant. The friend replied 'I'M CRYING'. Who's the friend that makes you cry on your birthday?

title: Scorpio is still mad about 2019
old_caption: Smiling at the party while the 2019 file sits open: 'didn't laugh at my joke'. Turns out they were just nervous. One file closed, plenty more in the cabinet. What year is your grudge from?

title: Sagittarius swore off dating (on Saturday)
old_caption: Saturday brunch: a toast, a banner, a FREE ERA sash. Saturday night: one little reply. Sunday: a date, sash still on. Nineteen hours. How long did your last era last?

title: Taurus stayed dressed for cancelled plans
old_caption: Three outfits, the good shoes, then 'can we do next week?' So Taurus cooked dinner in the outfit and took a selfie with the plant. Do you change or stay dressed?

title: Aquarius explained lighthouses for forty minutes
old_caption: 'So what are you into?' Forty minutes and three napkin diagrams later, the date leaned in and asked how the lens works. Then pulled out a napkin of their own. What would your forty-minute topic be?

title: Aries, caught five times before bedtime
old_caption: Six snoozes, an argument with a parking meter, a trench paced into a cafe floor and a text in all caps. Catch number five is the one Aries is proud of. Which catch is most you?

title: Cancer, a whole day caught in 4K
old_caption: Hugged the delivery driver, reread a two-year-old chat 'for research', cooked dinner for six for one. Then a friend showed up with soup, and this time it was for Cancer. Who brings you the soup?

title: Libra, caught deciding all day
old_caption: Twenty minutes on two identical sweaters. 'Anywhere!' then 'not there.' Agreeing with both sides of a fight. Then one question that took Libra no time at all. What's the one thing you never overthink?

title: Scorpio, five catches in one day
old_caption: Sunglasses indoors, a heartfelt paragraph replaced by 'k', mouthing every word of a song they've 'never heard'. Then movie night with Pisces, and the sunglasses go back on for a reason. Mysterious or soft?
